songs.title: The Final Countdown
songs.composition_rights: Copyrighted composition; CC0 applies only to the source fart recordings
songs.arrangement: Arena-rock fart fanfare with sustained recorded-fart lead, octave brass, galloping bass, chord replies, wet rock backbeat, short puffs, phrase fills and comic finale
songs.source_notation: Pitches, exact sixteenth/eighth-note rhythm and ties visually checked against the piano melody on printed pages 1-4 of arranger Pierre Loiselle's self-published score. Uses its bars 1-8, then 13-16, with an added F# minor cadence. Lead uses original-key pitches C#5/B4/F#4/D5 etc. Tied notes are merged. The initial 1.5 beats of rest are omitted so the recognisable C#5-B4-C#5 fanfare starts instantly. Tempo 118 BPM and octave choices are arrangement decisions; this is an independently sequenced fart arrangement, not original-recording audio. Harmonic extensions are optional accompaniment colour.

songs.title: The Imperial March
songs.composition_rights: Copyrighted composition; CC0 applies only to the source fart recordings
songs.arrangement: Marching fart brass band with sustained recorded-fart lead, octave brass, heavy bass steps, chord replies, alternating side rolls, phrase fills and comic finale
songs.source_notation: Melody and note durations visually checked against the official Faber/Warner-Chappell piano sample, printed page 28, bars 5-16 (the 4-bar introduction is omitted). The publisher sample is marked approximately 100 BPM; 108 BPM is the creative arrangement tempo. All melody pitches are transposed down one octave from that piano notation. The defining figures use dotted eighth + sixteenth (0.75 + 0.25 quarter-note beats), not straight eighths or triplets. F# and Eb in the upper chromatic descent are enharmonic spellings of the printed F# and D#. Chord events below are simplified arrangement guidance, not a transcription of the original orchestration.
